trophies.guide: The platinum pops once the other 54 are earned. No online play or DLC is needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the first Chapter 1 mission, Gone Fishing.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops as Chapter 2 opens, when its first mission, What's in the Bag?, starts.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 3 begins, right after the Welcome to Vice City mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when Chapter 4 is done.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the story's final mission; free-roam stays open afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% completion. The checklist opens in Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story, but progress made during the story already counts. Only about 60% of everything in the game is actually required, so follow the partial targets in Stage 2 of the roadmap.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts out of 397 in the game, mixing the four types: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under the bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Going under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. Track it in Progress, Activities, Stunts; 100% needs 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one ball), an arcade game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone), and a stunt. Check Progress, Activities; most come naturally from the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough for the trophy. Full 100% needs all 42 drone races.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 race locations, and winning the same race twice does not count twice.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple icon). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game to the end; you do not need every challenge in it. The four games are Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind (on the home TV) and Bang For Your Buck (arcade machines out in the world). Available from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline, played as Lucia, is marked automatically in Chapter 3 (a call plus a text with his Belville home address). Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (starting Cellerica), Read the Label (fetch the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (the warehouse). Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the Island Dreams mission (green KR icon at Key Lento). Recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks (purple crate icons; dig with a metal detector on the sea floor) and bring it to Kenton. He is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1, then returns in Chapters 2-3; as Jason you can speed that up by phoning Brian in Chapter 2. Track it in Progress, Characters, Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands that count. Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count. The full list of 8 is still being confirmed, so watch the trophy's progress counter in the trophy list. All available after the story. Caution: Yago's Race Against Yago is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so do it when it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list opens automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and get the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with WAiNK to check if one is on the list; they often park around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels. Better condition pays more. Track it in Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline, played as Jason, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the synth labs (purple icons, quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then the final quest Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) gives the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations; meditating together as Jason and Lucia at one spot counts +2. Track it in Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to Jason's home balcony and choose Accept. It is not yet confirmed whether that meditation is required for the trophy, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. 100% only needs 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline, played as Jason, is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (a text from Bret; first quest Veteran Hunted in Lummox County). Hunt the animals his Target Deck asks for (purple icons) and bring the results to Bret. In the first quest he gives you the unique Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle, retrievable at an Ammu-Nation weapon locker. One clean shot gives pristine condition and better pay, but it is not required. The exact animal that triggers the trophy is still being confirmed. 100% needs all 15 Target Deck entries.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets; you do not need every set in the game. Progress per set shows in Progress, Collections.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app (hold D-pad up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 locations count, and 100% needs 100 too.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 challenges (8 categories of 10). Track them in Progress, Challenges. Many complete themselves as you play, and 100% needs 70, so this trophy usually arrives on the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and get out of the red heat zone (not just the flashing blue/red search area). Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together; call your partner with hold right D-pad plus Triangle. Easy spot: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, Kelly County, where police and helicopters struggle to follow. It often pops on its own during big bank vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row WITHOUT losing your wanted level (stay in the flashing red/blue state; if the stars vanish, the chain breaks). Bring body armour, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and healing items (Zombix or Adrenaline). The 3 jewellery shops in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, sit close together and suit this. The trophy can pop about 30 seconds late after the third shop; if it never comes, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Find 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold D-pad up, then R1); you do not need to drive them. Fastest: stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. There are 557 vehicles in the game; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models. Track it in Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in ONE use of Combat Focus (activate with L3+R3 while aiming; time slows and enemy weak points are highlighted, using the purple focus bar). Fill focus first (eat and drink, wash or shower at home; Adrenaline stretches it), use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556, and face a group of enemies — gang members in a Gang Operation suit this. It does NOT count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised through the Shooting Range, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is DOCKED at a boarding bridge at VCIA — planes parked out on the field do not count. Easiest at departures terminal E3/E4: smash through the airfield fence, climb the stairs beside the boarding bridge, enter through the door, go up to the cockpit, reverse the plane onto the runway, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport until the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map (Mariana County); the tanks sit south of the base. Enter through the gate or by stunt jump near the south-east door, climb in and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it gives you the Snap Gun (for opening alarmed doors silently) and unlocks jewellery store robberies (green icons in opened map areas). Enter a jewellery store through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and leave undetected. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It opens through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): follow the security van to the bank and enter as the guard opens the vault. Bring a partner (the money bags are too heavy for one person; hand one over with hold right D-pad). After that mission, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 — first finish his quests, robbing 2 Payday Loans. A vault robbery always gives 4 stars; escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total and 100% needs all 8; one robbery pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. It counts automatically during the bank vault robbery in That's Where The Money Is…, where you tail the security truck to the bank. Earlier option: ambush an armoured truck passing near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door, blow it and escape the red heat zone (or reach a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are available behind Yasmani's shop after his quest.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map (52 areas). Fastest: fly a plane over every fogged area.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs (yellow icons on the map as you approach; many are marked automatically as the story progresses). Track it in Progress, Gangs. 100% needs all 39 operations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx / GTABase, 19 Nov 2026). The official description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — GTABase reads that as drinking a cocktail at a scenic spot on Ocean Beach, Vice City, but that is an interpretation, not a confirmed step. Do not trust any unlock steps until a source confirms them.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx / GTABase, 19 Nov 2026). The description suggests crashing a car out through a showroom window — GTABase offers that as an interpretation, not a confirmed step. No unlock method is verified yet.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling (a Kolt & Associates gang operation) in Port Gellhorn — first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take 3 valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table) and the safe's contents (north-east corridor; blow it with a sticky bomb, bought first at Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. Not missable: if something is left behind, this operation respawns (slowly) and the rest can be collected later; all 3 in one visit is not required.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength for Jason AND Lucia at the same time. Check Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Strength (heart icon). Start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Work out at a gym (buy a membership; filter Map, Activities) and always bring your partner (hold right D-pad plus Triangle) — when one character trains, the partner trains automatically. After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile (the counter shows when you click the trophy in the trophy list). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications — a devil-face icon appears for each counted action. Robberies and fights all count, so it usually comes passively while chasing other trophies and 100%. PowerPyx suggests farming it by running over pedestrians or police with a car if you are short — but beware: the top profile level, Irredeemable, is permanent, and police then shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx / GTABase, 19 Nov 2026). The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. PowerPyx guesses it may relate to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — a guess, not a fact. No unlock method is verified yet.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx / GTABase, 19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx guesses it may come from a UFO questline and GTABase expects a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida — both are guesses, not confirmed steps. No unlock method is verified yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx / GTABase, 19 Nov 2026). PowerPyx guesses it may involve kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle and GTABase reads it as knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — both are guesses, not confirmed steps. No unlock method is verified yet.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (cumulative, not all at once). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). A bank vault pays up to $205,000 in one robbery. It comes naturally from robbing for 100%.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops (cumulative). Fastest: weapons, car mods and tattoos (the priciest). Shops in the game include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair & beauty, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages sold through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone (it opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses; a new-app notification appears). Total about $160,000. The 4 garages from the story do NOT count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you bring a vehicle to Moses). Take a stolen vehicle to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. At first Moses only takes vehicles without a tracker; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker vehicles can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need an empty garage slot (see Little Boxes), registration costs money — use cheap cars or bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
